solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Ravenous Clegg hoped to leave pound for a bit of food

indicators.note: ravenous suggests wild, frenzied behaviour, so the letters are thrown about into a new order
to leave ... for says one letter departs and another takes its place

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound (from Latin libra)

explanation.surface: Former Lib Dem leader Nick Clegg, starving, hopes to spend less than a pound on a snack.
explanation.walkthrough: In CLEGGHOPED the L (pound) leaves and A comes in for it; 'Ravenous' then rearranges the resulting letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A poached egg is a small dish, an example of a bit of food.

clue.text: Love bachelor? Wait and see

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, shaped like the letter O
B is the abbreviation for bachelor, as in BA
to wait at table is to serve

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a lover is still single and is told to wait and find out.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe something is to notice or see it; the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Animal's timid, then excited when lifted

parts.note: coy means shy or timid

indicators.note: in a down entry, lifting a word turns it to read upwards, so it is reversed

parts.note: to be up is to be excited or worked up

explanation.surface: A creature is shy but gets agitated when picked up.
explanation.definitionFit: The coypu is a large South American rodent, an example of an animal.

clue.text: Are reforms grasped by independent body? I ignored plea

indicators.note: grasped by means held inside the following piece
ignored says the letter named just before it is left out

parts.note: an entity is a thing with independent existence, a body in its own right

indicators.note: reforms means the preceding word is re-formed into another order

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether an independent regulator will take on reforms, and their plea is disregarded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'independent body' reads as a regulator, but it is a thing existing in its own right; 'I ignored' drops a letter from it before 'reforms' goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest request, a synonym for a plea.

clue.text: Former lover transforming into a calm man!

definitions.text: Former lover transforming into a calm man!

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: transforming means the words beside it are changed into a new arrangement

parts.note: Mark is a man's name

explanation.surface: An ex-partner who used to rage has mellowed into a placid fellow, and the clue ends with a flourish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into a calm' rearranges to CLAMATION; the whole clue, ending in the very punctuation it names, is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The punctuation ending the clue is itself the thing defined, so the whole clue points at that symbol.

clue.text: How members might be described — no time to be sociable

indicators.note: no time means the letter for time is removed from the word before

parts.note: members here are private parts, which would be described as genital

explanation.surface: A club wonders how its members could be described, with no time to be friendly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'members' looks like club membership, but it is the risque sense of body parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Genial means friendly and warm, so a near synonym of sociable.

clue.text: You can cook in this stove now jam's wiped off

indicators.note: wiped off says the letters of the word before are removed from the phrase

parts.note: the phrase the jam is wiped from; that the result also runs inside it is a coincidence of the deletion, not a separate hidden-word device
to stow is to cram or jam something in

explanation.surface: A cook cleans jam off the stove so it can be used.
explanation.walkthrough: S, T and then O, W are taken out of STOVENOW in that order, leaving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An oven is a cooking compartment, described here by its use.

clue.text: Wild roar having trapped trunk — trumpeter found here?

indicators.note: having trapped means the first piece holds the second inside it
wild means the letters run riot into a new order

parts.note: the trunk of the body is the chest

explanation.surface: An elephant trumpets with a wild roar, its trunk caught in something.
explanation.walkthrough: Trunk and trumpeter suggest an elephant, but the trunk is the torso and the trumpeter is a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: A trumpet player would be found in an orchestra, so the definition describes a place by who is there.

clue.text: Chopper turns up to extract vet

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means reading from bottom to top, reversed

parts.note: an axe is a chopping tool
to mine is to extract minerals from the ground

explanation.surface: A chopper appears to extract something for a veterinary surgeon.
explanation.definitionFit: To vet something is to check or inspect it closely, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Son in Youth Hostel Association turning pale

indicators.note: in puts the son inside the organisation's letters
turning means the initials are read backwards

parts.note: YHA is the abbreviation of the Youth Hostel Association

explanation.surface: A son staying at a youth hostel goes pale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' makes AHY, and S goes in after the A. The YHA runs Britain's budget hostels.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashy means the grey colour of ashes, so pallid or pale.

clue.text: Work in ICT? He can

indicators.note: to work something is to knead or shape it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asked who can do a job in information technology, the reply is that he can.
explanation.walkthrough: ICT is information and communication technology. 'Work' looks like a noun, but it is the anagram signal on the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A technician is a skilled worker, the kind of person who can do IT work.

clue.text: Company's hairpiece not quite covering Roger's head

indicators.note: covering means the shortened word goes round the next letter
not quite means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a toupee is a small wig, a hairpiece

indicators.note: head means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A firm's wig doesn't quite hide Roger's bald head.
explanation.definitionFit: A troupe is a company of performers, such as actors or dancers.

clue.text: I came out to capture rat — impractical

indicators.note: to capture means the anagram holds the next piece inside it
out means the letters are put out of order

parts.note: a rat and a cad are both scoundrels

explanation.surface: Someone emerges to catch a rodent, which seems a hopeless plan.
explanation.walkthrough: I CAME rearranges to A...EMIC, which captures CAD.
explanation.definitionFit: Academic in the sense of theoretical rather than practical, so of no practical use.

clue.text: Deal with Spielberg film leads to the awful feud

parts.note: to vend is to sell, to deal in goods
ET is Steven Spielberg's 1982 film

indicators.note: leads to means the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A deal involving a Spielberg film ends in an ugly dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: A vendetta is a prolonged bitter quarrel, a synonym for feud.

clue.text: Paint good-looking person almost sitting on cushion

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a dish is slang for an attractive person
to temper is to soften or cushion a blow

explanation.surface: A painter notes a handsome person nearly settled on a cushion.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'sitting on' puts the first piece above the second; it is the joining word here.
explanation.definitionFit: Distemper is a kind of water-based paint used on walls.

clue.text: Golfer leaving end of driving range

indicators.note: leaving means a letter departs from the golfer's name

parts.note: Tiger Woods is a famous golfer

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A golfer walks off the end of the driving range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driving range' reads as a practice ground, but 'range' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is a row or level, as a range of seats is a row of them.

clue.text: Relative goes round wearing black

indicators.note: goes round means the first piece surrounds the second

parts.note: a sister is a relative
in can mean wearing, as in dressed in

explanation.surface: A relative goes about dressed in black, as if in mourning.
explanation.definitionFit: Black in the sense of evil or menacing, which sinister also means.

clue.text: Imprisons writers

definitions.meaning: to pen is to shut in or confine

explanation.definitionFit: Pen as a verb means to enclose; as a noun it is an instrument for writing.

clue.text: Sally perhaps excited, initially, by two farmyard animals

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word

parts.note: a pig is a farmyard animal
a ram is another farmyard animal

explanation.surface: A girl named Sally gets excited by a couple of farm animals.
explanation.walkthrough: Sally looks like a woman's name, but it is a witty remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a witty retort, an example of a pithy saying.

clue.text: One that apes attacked to maim it — male abandoned by river

indicators.note: attacked suggests the words are set upon and broken up into a new order
abandoned by means one letter is dropped and another put in its place

explanation.surface: A creature that apes others attacked to injure someone, while a man was left by the river.
explanation.walkthrough: One M of TOMAIMIT gives way to R, and the letters are then rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To ape is to mimic, so one who apes is a mimic.

clue.text: Sketch revealed route

parts.note: a secret that is out has been revealed
a line is a route, as in a railway line

explanation.surface: A drawing shows the road.
explanation.definitionFit: An outline is a rough sketch or summary of something.

clue.text: Stop exercise

definitions.meaning: a stopping place for vehicles, a lay-by or roadside halt
a gym exercise of raising the body to a bar

explanation.definitionFit: The noun names both a roadside halt for vehicles and a chin-to-bar gym movement.

clue.text: In error, remove rough edges from facial hair

indicators.note: in means the following piece goes inside the error

parts.note: a sin is a moral error
to debur or deburr is to remove rough edges from metal

explanation.surface: Someone mistakenly tries to trim the rough edges from their beard.
explanation.definitionFit: Sideburns are strips of hair down the side of the face.

clue.text: Draw power from pint I've drunk

indicators.note: drunk means the letters are befuddled into a new order
power from means the letter for power is taken from the words

explanation.surface: A drinker gets strength from a pint they have downed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Draw' looks like a verb about pulling, but it is the definition in the sense of attract.
explanation.definitionFit: To invite is to attract or tempt, as to draw a crowd.

clue.text: TV static oddly distorted view

indicators.note: distorted means the letters are bent into a new order
oddly means the letters in odd positions, first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: Interference on the television distorts the picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes SAI from static; with TV these five letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A vista is a pleasing view, especially a long one.

clue.text: Plan petrol changes for driver

indicators.note: changes means the words' letters are altered in order

explanation.surface: A scheme to alter fuel for a motorist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driver' suggests a motorist, but here it is what drives a rocket or engine.
explanation.definitionFit: A propellant is a substance that propels, so a driving force.

clue.text: Prison riot

explanation.definitionFit: The word is slang for a jail and also means a fuss or uproar.

clue.text: Eastern master; I rule

definitions.meaning: a Muslim ruler or commander in the Middle East
what such a ruler might say of himself, a cryptic second definition

explanation.definitionFit: An emir is a Muslim ruler or prince in the Middle East, who governs his people.

clue.text: Resisted following goad by Queen — not giving anything away

indicators.note: following means the word before it comes after the next pieces

parts.note: to poke is to prod or goad
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen
to face down an enemy is to resist them

explanation.surface: Someone resisted after being prodded by the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A deadpan expression reveals nothing, which is what an inscrutable face does.
